verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government intellectual-property office, and such an office could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only patent, trademark and design filing procedures, plus online filing and appointment guides. Nothing documents an API, an interactive reference or runnable examples, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
